description: Negative control: a case with an unverifiable expected result and a copy of an existing case under another title.

analysis.summary: Role check, authentication, name validation, status-dependent updates and not-found handling. Order of the 403 and 404 checks is unspecified.

acceptance_criteria.text: PATCH /api/promotions/{id} requires the role promotion_editor; callers without it receive HTTP 403 and the promotion is unchanged.
The field name is required and must be 3 to 80 characters long; violations return HTTP 422 with the field name in the error body.
Only promotions in Draft or Scheduled status can be updated; updating an Active or Ended promotion returns HTTP 409.
A request for a promotion id that does not exist returns HTTP 404.

findings.text: Does a caller without promotion_editor get 403 or 404 for a promotion id that does not exist?
Are leading and trailing spaces counted in the length and is the name trimmed?
Can a Scheduled promotion be updated after its start time but before the scheduler activates it?

risks.description: Active promotions change while players use them.
